name: home-assistant-solar
description: Read-only Home Assistant solar and GivEnergy battery context for forecasts and charge recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Read live solar and battery state safely.
interface.longDescription: Uses a narrowly exposed Home Assistant Assist MCP connection to read seven GivTCP solar and battery sensors for forecasts and charge recommendations. It prohibits Home Assistant write and control actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my current Home Assistant solar and battery state, then summarize it without making any changes.
